nodes.statement: Fix one selected target H, reporting calibration domain, target domain, bearer, interval, complete application signature and separately typed formation, actual-use, evidence, marker and outcome variables.
nodes.scope: Selected retentive-familiarity evidence; not basal-experience admission.
nodes.quantifier: For every application electing to use R200 calibration.

nodes.statement: A finite proxy vector has class-conditional laws relative to an unsignated binary H label and no independent positive semantic endpoint.
nodes.quantifier: For every finite proxy battery lacking an independently signed H channel.

nodes.statement: Complementing H and swapping the two class-conditional proxy laws preserves the full observable law, so multiple unsigned proxies do not self-anchor H.
nodes.scope: Declared finite mixture model; not all possible semantic theories.
nodes.quantifier: For every model in the unsigned proxy domain.

nodes.statement: A predeclared comparative human judgment has independently fixed positive H meaning, response-key provenance and strictly positive reliability in the calibration domain while remaining fallible evidence.
nodes.quantifier: For every calibration population where this premise is independently defended.

nodes.statement: The signed reliability inequality excludes the complemented H labeling inside the calibration domain without defining H by report.
nodes.scope: The fixed calibration target and domain only.
nodes.quantifier: For every instance satisfying the signed endpoint premise.

nodes.statement: No-report use retains the same H meaning and class-conditional marker law, or an explicitly bounded drift, across the declared domains.
nodes.scope: A named calibration-to-target domain pair and marker.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed no-report marker application.

nodes.statement: Cross established versus fresh formation with independently grounded actual same-episode route use versus physical bypass while measuring H evidence separately from success, ownership and agency.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed formation-by-use bridge test.

nodes.statement: A positive formation-by-use marker interaction can occur with H fixed, including when agreeing proxies share a success confound; interaction alone does not identify H.
nodes.scope: The enumerated Boolean design class and analogous unblocked confounding.
nodes.quantifier: For every inference relying only on the interaction sign.

nodes.statement: Keep actual organization/use, use evidence, selected H semantics, fallible human endpoint, objective marker and cross-domain transport separately signed; no successful test reverses these arrows.
nodes.scope: Evidence for the selected H coordinate; not a consciousness detector.
nodes.quantifier: For every future UCT H-bridge application.

rules.statement: Apply the H-complement and class-law swap to preserve the observable mixture.
rules.binding: One target, proxy vector, population and mixture law are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Supply an independently defended signed endpoint rather than adding more unsigned proxies.

rules.statement: Complementing H reverses the predeclared strict endpoint inequality and is excluded in the calibration domain.
rules.binding: One target meaning, response-key map, population and reliability inequality are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If signed reliability is not independently supported, retain the complement ambiguity.

rules.statement: Use the calibrated marker outside the reporting domain only under same-target class-conditional invariance or explicit drift bounds.
rules.binding: The same H meaning, marker measurement relation and named domain pair are used throughout.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Without transport evidence, report only the observed marker and organization manipulation.

rules.statement: Enumerate success-confounded Boolean response tables to show that positive interaction does not entail H change.
rules.binding: One formation/use factorial, outcome definition and fixed H assignment are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Add signed calibration, actual-use evidence and explicit confound controls for bounded evidence.

rules.statement: Combine the proxy ceiling, conditional orientation and interaction ceiling without conflating ontic use, evidence or transport.
rules.binding: One selected H target, bearer/domain contract and evidence architecture are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If any premise is absent, preserve H as open and report only the lower-level result.

context_links.statement: R200 neither proves nor replaces C1; calibration concerns evidence for one selected coordinate.
Report, marker calibration, familiarity and successful transport are not requirements for basal experience.
Route-use evidence does not replace actual prior occurrence, trace continuation and current consumer use.
A fallible endpoint supplies conditional evidence, not the definition of familiar mineness.
Empirical marker transport remains distinct from C1's typed structural transport.
